description: This is an inactive manhunter.  Manhacks are fist-sized robots that fly through the air.  This one is equipped with an smg and a large integrated magazine.  Use or throw this item to reprogram and activate the manhunter.  Electronics and computer skill determines if the targeting matrix is reprogrammed successfully.

use_action.friendly_msg: The manhunter flies from your hand and surveys the area!
use_action.hostile_msg: You misprogram the manhunter; it's hostile!

use_action.hostile_msg: A siren howls and lights flash as the police bot prepares to arrest you!
